claims.label: Contractor Breach / Negligence
claims.note: Catastrophic/life-safety failures anchor the top of the real-case range ($39M-$997M in the research sample). This defect type (workmanship cosmetic finish) is typically caught during commissioning or early occupancy rather than years later, so statute-of-repose exposure is usually much lower here than for a latent structural/geotechnical/water-intrusion defect.

outcome.description: After a two-day bench trial the court found for Windsor, awarded it $44,300 (the amount it had paid Speedy) plus prejudgment and postjudgment interest on its breach-of-contract counterclaim and $3,960 on its slander-of-title counterclaim (bond premiums), a total of $48,260, voided Speedy's $66,000 mechanics lien and denied Speedy's claims. The Second District affirmed.
